scope: isolated acceptance PG (compose.pg18.yml) port publishing on Docker Desktop / Engine 29

symptom.observed: NetworkSettings.Ports == {"5432/tcp":[]}; `docker port` empty; host psql -> Connection refused; stop/start did NOT restore binding

diagnosis: host port 25432 free (lsof -iTCP:25432 -sTCP:LISTEN rc=1); docker engine 29.8.1 healthy
full `docker compose down && up -d` recreate: same empty Ports on fresh container => not stale-state
control probe A: `docker run -p 127.0.0.1:25499:80 nginx:alpine` on DEFAULT bridge -> docker port OK, curl 200 => Docker Desktop port forwarding globally functional
control probe B: nginx on a `--internal` network with -p 127.0.0.1:25498:80 -> NetworkSettings.Ports {"80/tcp":[]}, docker port empty => reproduced
root cause: Docker Engine 29 silently drops port publishing for containers whose ONLY network is internal:true

fixes.change: networks.acceptance: internal:true -> driver:bridge with explanatory comment
fixes.isolation_note: isolation substance retained: tmpfs ephemeral PGDATA, pull_policy never, published port bound to 127.0.0.1 only, dedicated synthetic credentials, dedicated project-scoped network (not the default bridge)

fixes.change: after initdb, append pg_hba.conf rule `host all all 172.16.0.0/12 scram-sha-256` (image pg_hba only allowed local/127.0.0.1/::1; host connections arrive from docker bridge gateway 172.20.0.1)
fixes.isolation_note: scram-sha-256 still enforced; only private docker ranges accepted

verification.health: healthy ~10s after recreate; TimescaleDB background launcher connected in logs

host_psql.command: PGPASSWORD=<synthetic, not stored> psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 25432 -U imboy_acceptance -d imboy_acceptance
